name: Tomache Masaryk
original_name: トマーシュ・マサリク
source:
From: Mobile Suit V Gundam
A boy who lived aboard the Solar Energy Generation Satellite Hiland. He opposed the methods of the Zanscare Empire, and eventually started helping the League Militaire together with his family and friends.
translation:
